_about: Synthetic three-slide deck used to check rendering and export without any provider call. All content is invented for the tests.
title: Fjordlight bike-share pilot

slides.title: Fjordlight bike-share pilot
slides.body: A synthetic sample deck for the design tests
slides.notes: Introduce the pilot. This deck is synthetic test material.

slides.title: From station to ferry in four steps
slides.body:
Find a bike — Stations sit next to the ferry stops
Unlock — Scan the code on the dock
Ride — Short trips across the district
Return — Dock at any station near the water
slides.notes: Walk through the four steps a rider takes.

slides.title: Start with one district
slides.body:
Agree on the pilot district
Collect usage data for one season
Decide on winter use
slides.notes: Close with the three decisions we need.
